### Defining functions
```{r Making_Plotting_Function, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
plot_stage <- function(stage_name, data, ann_colors) {
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(Stage == stage_name)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = log2CPM)) +
    
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(fill = Species, group = interaction(Timepoint, Species)),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      alpha = 0.3,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = ann_colors$species_cor) +
    
    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = Individual),
      position = position_jitterdodge(
        jitter.width = 0.15,
        dodge.width = 0.8
      ),
      size = 1,
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = ann_colors$individual_cor) +
    
    geom_line(
      stat = "summary",
      fun = mean,
      aes(group = Species, linetype = Species),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(C = "dotted", H = "solid")) +
    
    geom_point(
      stat = "summary",
      fun = mean,
      aes(shape = Species),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      size = 2
    ) +
    
    facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
    
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    
    ggtitle(stage_name)
}
```

## Read statistics

### Data preparation
```{r RNASeq_Statistics_data}

RNA_fc <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/RNA_fc.RDS")

total_reads_df <- RNA_fc %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(Gene = rownames(.)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Gene) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "Total_Counts"
  ) %>%
  left_join(RNA_Metadata, by = c("Sample" = "SampleName"))

day_levels <- c("Day0","Day2","Day4","Day5","Day15","Day30")

total_reads_df <- total_reads_df %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = day_levels, ordered = TRUE),

    # force species order: chimp first, human second
    Species = factor(Species, levels = c("C", "H")),

    Individual_Color = ann_colors$individual_cor[Individual]
  ) %>%
  arrange(Species, Individual, Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(Sample = factor(Sample, levels = Sample))

# saveRDS(total_reads_df,"data/Raw_Data/concat/total_reads_df.RDS")

```

### By sample
```{r RNASeq_perSample_graph, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}

total_reads_df <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/total_reads_df.RDS")

ggplot(total_reads_df, aes(x = Sample, y = Total_Reads, fill = Timepoint)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Individual, color = Individual), 
            y = 0, angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ann_colors$timepoint_cor) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ann_colors$individual_cor) +
  facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top") +
  labs(
    title = "Total Reads per Sample",
    x = "Individual",
    y = "Total Reads",
    fill = "Timepoint",
    color = "Individual"
  )

ggplot(total_reads_df, aes(x = Sample, y = Mapped_Reads, fill = Timepoint)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Individual, color = Individual), 
            y = 0, angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ann_colors$timepoint_cor) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ann_colors$individual_cor) +
  facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top") +
  labs(
    title = "Mapped Reads per Sample",
    x = "Individual",
    y = "Mapped Reads",
    fill = "Timepoint",
    color = "Individual"
  )

ggplot(total_reads_df, aes(x = Sample, y = Percent_Mapped, fill = Timepoint)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Individual, color = Individual), 
            y = 0, angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ann_colors$timepoint_cor) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ann_colors$individual_cor) +
  facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top") +
  labs(
    title = "Percent Mapping per Sample",
    x = "Individual",
    y = "Percent Mapping",
    fill = "Timepoint",
    color = "Individual"
  )

ggplot(total_reads_df, aes(x = Sample, y = Usable_Fragments, fill = Timepoint)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Individual, color = Individual), 
            y = 0, angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ann_colors$timepoint_cor) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ann_colors$individual_cor) +
  facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top") +
  labs(
    title = "Usable Fragments per Sample",
    x = "Individual",
    y = "Number Fragments",
    fill = "Timepoint",
    color = "Individual"
  )
```

```{r RNASeq_perIndividualbySpecies_graph, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
    ~ Species,
```

```{r RNASeq_Purities,results="hide", fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
# -----------------------------
# 1. Prepare long-format data
# -----------------------------
day_levels <- c("Day0","Day2","Day4","Day5","Day15","Day30")
marker_levels <- c("OCT3/4", "Brachy", "ISL-1", "TNNT-2")

RNA_Metadata_NoRep <- RNA_Metadata %>%
  dplyr::filter(!SampleName %in% c(
    "H20682R_Day0",
    "H20682R_Day2",
    "H20682R_Day5",
    "H20682R_Day30"
  ))

df_long_all <- RNA_Metadata_NoRep %>%
  dplyr::select(Individual,Cond, `OCT3/4`, Brachy, `ISL-1`, `TNNT-2`,Species) %>%
  mutate(
    `OCT3/4` = as.numeric(`OCT3/4`),
    Brachy = as.numeric(Brachy),
    `ISL-1` = as.numeric(`ISL-1`),
    `TNNT-2` = as.numeric(`TNNT-2`),
    Group = ifelse(grepl("^H_", Cond), "H", "C")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`OCT3/4`, Brachy, `ISL-1`, `TNNT-2`),
    names_to = "Marker",
    values_to = "Percent_Positive"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Day = gsub(".*_(Day\\d+)$", "\\1", Cond),
    Day = factor(Day, levels = day_levels, ordered = TRUE),
    Marker = factor(Marker, levels = marker_levels, ordered = TRUE)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 2. Compute summary with SEM
# -----------------------------
summary_df <- df_long_all %>%
  group_by(Marker, Day, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
    N = sum(!is.na(Percent_Positive)),
    SEM = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

library(dplyr)

results <- df_long_all %>%
  group_by(Day, Marker, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
    N    = sum(!is.na(Percent_Positive)),
    SEM  = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Group,
    values_from = c(Mean,Median, SD, SEM, N),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    df_long_all %>%
      group_by(Day, Marker) %>%
      summarise(
        p_value = t.test(Percent_Positive ~ Group)$p.value,
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("Day", "Marker")
  )



#Plot lines over time with SEM error bars

ggplot(summary_df,
       aes(x = Day, y = Median,
           linetype = Group,
           group = Group)) +

  # Individual points
  geom_point(
    data = df_long_all,
    aes(
      x = Day,
      y = Percent_Positive,
      color = Individual,
      shape = Group
    ),
    size = 2.5,
    alpha = 0.9,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0)
  ) +

  # Mean line (black, texture = species)
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Mean point (black)
  geom_point(
    size = 0.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Error bars (black)
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SD, ymax = Mean + SD),
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Marker, nrow = 1) +

  # species as line texture
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "H" = "solid",
      "C" = "dashed"
    ),
    name = "Species"
  ) +

  # species as shape
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "H" = 17,  # triangle
      "C" = 16   # circle
    ),
    name = "Species"
  ) +

  # individual colors from your manual palette
  scale_color_manual(
    values = ann_colors$individual_cor,
    name = "Individual"
  ) +

  # Use coord_cartesian instead of scale_y_continuous to avoid dropped points
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +

  labs(
    title = "Median Percent Positive Across Timepoints for Each Marker",
    x = "Day",
    y = "Mean Percent Positive (%)",
    caption = "Color = individual, shape/line = species, error bars = SD"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "italic", size = 10)
  )
```

```{r RNASeq_Purities_stats, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}

species_stats <- function(df) {

  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Day), !is.na(Group), !is.na(Percent_Positive)) %>%
    group_by(Group, Day, Marker) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      Mean = mean(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = median(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
      SEM = SD / sqrt(N),
      Min = min(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
      Max = max(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q1 = quantile(Percent_Positive, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q3 = quantile(Percent_Positive, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

species_stats <- species_stats(df_long_all)

species_stats

Timepoint_stats <- function(df) {

  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Day), !is.na(Percent_Positive)) %>%
    group_by(Day, Marker) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      Mean = mean(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = median(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
      SEM = SD / sqrt(N),
      Min = min(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
      Max = max(Percent_Positive, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q1 = quantile(Percent_Positive, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q3 = quantile(Percent_Positive, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

Timepoint_stats <- Timepoint_stats(df_long_all)

Timepoint_stats

```

```{r RNASeq_Purities_HvC_stats, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}

run_HC_stats <- function(df, correction = "BH") {

  results <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Day), !is.na(Group), !is.na(Percent_Positive)) %>%
    group_by(Day, Marker) %>%
    summarise(
      H_Mean = mean(Percent_Positive[Group == "H"], na.rm = TRUE),
      C_Mean = mean(Percent_Positive[Group == "C"], na.rm = TRUE),
      H_SD = sd(Percent_Positive[Group == "H"], na.rm = TRUE),
      C_SD = sd(Percent_Positive[Group == "C"], na.rm = TRUE),
      H_N = sum(Group == "H"),
      C_N = sum(Group == "C"),
      p_value = t.test(
        Percent_Positive ~ Group,
        data = pick(Percent_Positive, Group),
        var.equal = FALSE
      )$p.value,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Day) %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = correction),
      Significance = case_when(
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  return(results)
}


HC_stats <- run_HC_stats(df_long_all)

HC_stats
```

### Cor_HeatMap_Unfiltered
```{r RNASeq_FeatureCounts_Cor_RMG0_PerDay, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
###### Align Metadata with RNA_log2cpm ###### 

# Match metadata rows to the order of RNA_log2cpm columns 
RNA_Metadata <- RNA_Metadata[ match(colnames(RNA_log2cpm), RNA_Metadata$SampleName), ] 

# Check that all samples matched 
stopifnot(all(RNA_Metadata$SampleName == colnames(RNA_log2cpm))) 

# Optional: check for missing metadata 
stopifnot(!any(is.na(RNA_Metadata$SampleName)))

######Cor_HeatMap####
Cor_RNA_log2cpm <- cor(RNA_log2cpm, method = "spearman")
individual <- RNA_Metadata$Individual
species <- RNA_Metadata$Species
timepoint <- RNA_Metadata$Timepoint
timepoint <- factor(timepoint,levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day4","Day5","Day15","Day30"))
Cor_metadata <- data.frame(
  sample_cor = colnames(Cor_RNA_log2cpm),
  species_cor = species,
  timepoint_cor = timepoint,
  individual_cor = individual
)


rownames(Cor_metadata) <- Cor_metadata$sample_cor

print(
  pheatmap(Cor_RNA_log2cpm,
         fontsize_row = 5,
         fontsize_col = 5,
         annotation_col = Cor_metadata[, c("species_cor", "timepoint_cor","individual_cor")],
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
         clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
         main = "Sample-Sample Correlation \n(Spearman-log2CPM-Unfiltered)")
)

# saveRDS(Cor_RNA_log2cpm, "data/QC/concat/Cor_RNA_log2cpm.RDS")
# saveRDS(Cor_metadata, "data/QC/concat/Cor_RNA_metadata.RDS")
```

```{r RNASeq_FeatureCounts_Raw_Correlation_No4, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
RNA_fc <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/RNA_fc.RDS")

metadata <- RNA_Metadata_No4
counts <- RNA_fc %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("Day4"))
  

# Make sure metadata follows the count matrix
metadata <- metadata[
    match(colnames(counts), metadata$SampleName),
]

metadata <- metadata %>% 
  filter(Individual != "H4R")

counts <- counts %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("R"))

metadata$dgelist <- c(rep(c("Human_Day0","Human_Day2","Human_Day5","Human_Day15","Human_Day30","Chimp_Day0","Chimp_Day2","Chimp_Day5","Chimp_Day15","Chimp_Day30"),7))

#create DGEList object
dge <- DGEList(counts = counts)
dge$samples$group <- factor(metadata$dgelist)
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
dge$samples

dim(dge)
dge$samples

log2cpm <- cpm(dge, log=TRUE)

# Match metadata rows to the order of RNA_log2cpm columns 
metadata <- metadata[ match(colnames(log2cpm), metadata$SampleName), ] 

# Check that all samples matched 
stopifnot(all(metadata$SampleName == colnames(log2cpm))) 

# Optional: check for missing metadata 
stopifnot(!any(is.na(metadata$SampleName)))

######Cor_HeatMap####
Cor_log2cpm <- cor(log2cpm, method = "spearman")
individual <- metadata$Individual
species <- metadata$Species
timepoint <- metadata$Timepoint
timepoint <- factor(timepoint,levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day5","Day15","Day30"))
Cor_metadata <- data.frame(
  sample_cor = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
  species_cor = species,
  timepoint_cor = timepoint,
  individual_cor = individual
)

rownames(Cor_metadata) <- Cor_metadata$sample_cor


print(
  pheatmap(Cor_log2cpm,
         fontsize_row = 5,
         fontsize_col = 5,
         annotation_col = Cor_metadata[, c("species_cor", "timepoint_cor","individual_cor")],
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
         clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
         main = "Sample-Sample Correlation \n(Spearman) \nNoRep")
)
```

### Markers_Unfiltered
```{r RNASeq_MarkerGenes_dataset, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
markers <- marker_genes$Ensembl.ID

log2cpm_long <- RNA_log2cpm %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Ensembl.ID") %>%
  filter(Ensembl.ID %in% markers) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Ensembl.ID,
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "log2CPM"
  )

log2cpm_long <- log2cpm_long %>%
  left_join(RNA_Metadata, by = c("Sample" = "SampleName"))

log2cpm_long <- log2cpm_long %>%
  left_join(marker_genes, by = "Ensembl.ID",relationship = "many-to-many")

log2cpm_long$Timepoint <- factor(
  log2cpm_long$Timepoint,
  levels = c("Day0", "Day2", "Day4", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")
)

log2cpm_long_NoR <- log2cpm_long %>% 
  filter(Individual != "H4R")

mean_df <- log2cpm_long_NoR %>%
  group_by(Stage, Timepoint, Species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_log2CPM = mean(log2CPM),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

log2cpm_long_NoR$Stage <- factor(
  log2cpm_long_NoR$Stage,
  levels = c(
    "Pluripotency",
    "Mesoderm",
    "CardiacMesoderm",
    "CardiacProgenitors",
    "EarlyCardiomyocytes",
    "MatureCardiomyocytes"
  )
)

# saveRDS(log2cpm_long_NoR,"data/QC/concat/markers_long_No4.RDS")
```

```{r RNASeq_MarkerGenes_graph, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}

log2cpm_long_NoR <-readRDS("data/QC/concat/markers_long_No4.RDS")

ggplot(log2cpm_long_NoR, aes(
  x = Timepoint,
  y = log2CPM
)) +

  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Stage),
    alpha = 0.3,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data = mean_df,
    aes(
      x = Timepoint,
      y = mean_log2CPM,
      group = interaction(Stage, Species),
      linetype = Species
    ),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = mean_df,
    aes(
      x = Timepoint,
      y = mean_log2CPM,
      shape = Species
    ),
    color = "black",
    size = 2
  ) +

  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
    C = "dotted",
    H = "solid"
  )) +

  scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    C = 16,
    H = 17
  )) +

  facet_wrap(~ factor(Stage, levels = levels(log2cpm_long_NoR$Stage))) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r RNASeq_FeatureCounts_FullMarkerPanel_FullHeatMap, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}

log2cpm_long_NoR <-readRDS("data/QC/concat/markers_long_No4.RDS")

mat <- log2cpm_long_NoR %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene, Sample) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(log2CPM = mean(log2CPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = log2CPM) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

stage_order <- c(
  "Pluripotency",
  "Mesoderm",
  "CardiacMesoderm",
  "CardiacProgenitors",
  "EarlyCardiomyocytes",
  "MatureCardiomyocytes"
)

gene_annot <- log2cpm_long_NoR %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Stage) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Stage = factor(Stage, levels = stage_order)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Stage)

mat <- mat[gene_annot$Gene, ]

gene_annot <- data.frame(Stage = gene_annot$Stage)
rownames(gene_annot) <- gene_annot$Gene

tp_order <- c("Day0", "Day2", "Day4", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")

sample_annot <- log2cpm_long_NoR %>%
  distinct(Sample, Timepoint, Species, Individual) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = trimws(Timepoint)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Sample")

sample_annot <- sample_annot[colnames(mat), ]

rownames(sample_annot) <- sample_annot$Sample
sample_annot <- sample_annot[, c("Timepoint", "Species", "Individual")]

annotation_colors = list(
  Timepoint  = ann_colors$timepoint_cor,
  Species    = ann_colors$species_cor,
  Individual = ann_colors$individual_cor,

  Stage = c(
    Pluripotency = "#1f77b4",
    Mesoderm = "#ff7f0e",
    CardiacMesoderm = "yellow",
    CardiacProgenitors = "#2ca02c",
    EarlyCardiomyocytes = "#d62728",
    MatureCardiomyocytes = "#9467bd"
  )
)

pheatmap(
  mat,
  annotation_col = sample_annot,
  annotation_row = gene_annot,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100)
)
```

#### Variance

```{r RNASeq_Varinances, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
metadata <- RNA_Metadata
counts <- Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc

# Make sure metadata follows the count matrix
metadata <- metadata[
    match(colnames(counts), metadata$SampleName),
]

metadata <- metadata %>% 
  filter(Individual != "H4R")

counts <- counts %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("R"))

all(metadata$SampleName == colnames(counts))

table(metadata$Species, metadata$Timepoint)

metadata$dgelist <- paste(
    metadata$Species,
    metadata$Timepoint,
    sep = "_"
)

#create DGEList object
dge <- DGEList(counts = counts)
dge$samples$group <- factor(metadata$dgelist)
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
dge$samples

dim(dge)
dge$samples

log2cpm <- cpm(dge, log=TRUE)

# Make sure sample order matches expression matrix
meta <- metadata %>%
  filter(Species %in% c("H", "C"))

log2cpm <- log2cpm[, meta$SampleName]

# Calculate variance for every gene within each species × stage
variance_df <- map_dfr(unique(meta$Timepoint), function(tp) {

  samples_h <- meta$SampleName[
    meta$Timepoint == tp & meta$Species == "H"
  ]

  samples_c <- meta$SampleName[
    meta$Timepoint == tp & meta$Species == "C"
  ]

  tibble(
    Gene = rownames(log2cpm),
    Human_Var = apply(log2cpm[, samples_h, drop = FALSE], 1, var),
    Chimp_Var = apply(log2cpm[, samples_c, drop = FALSE], 1, var),
    Timepoint = tp
  )
})

variance_tests <- variance_df %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = wilcox.test(
      Human_Var,
      Chimp_Var,
      paired = TRUE
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>% 
       mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(
      Timepoint,
      levels = c("Day0", "Day2", "Day4", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(Timepoint)

variance_tests

library(ggplot2)

variance_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Human_Var, Chimp_Var),
    names_to = "Species",
    values_to = "Variance"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Species, y = Variance)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Timepoint, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_bw()

variance_df <- variance_df %>%
  mutate(
    log2_Var_Ratio = log2(Human_Var / Chimp_Var)
  )
variance_summary <- variance_df %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    Human_median = median(Human_Var, na.rm = TRUE),
    Chimp_median = median(Chimp_Var, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_log2_ratio = median(log2_Var_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )  %>%
       mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(
      Timepoint,
      levels = c("Day0", "Day2", "Day4", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(Timepoint)
  

variance_summary

ggplot(variance_df, aes(x = log2_Var_Ratio)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~Timepoint, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw()

variance_df <- variance_df %>%
  mutate(
    log2_Human_Var = log2(Human_Var),
    log2_Chimp_Var = log2(Chimp_Var),
    abs_log2_var_diff = abs(log2_Human_Var - log2_Chimp_Var)
  )

ggplot(variance_df, aes(x = abs_log2_var_diff)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100) +
  facet_wrap(~Timepoint) +
  theme_bw()

variance_df %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    Median = median(abs_log2_var_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q25 = quantile(abs_log2_var_diff, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q75 = quantile(abs_log2_var_diff, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pct_within_2fold = mean(abs_log2_var_diff <= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
       mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(
      Timepoint,
      levels = c("Day0", "Day2", "Day4", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(Timepoint)
```


```{r RNASeq_Varinances_graphs, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}

# 1. Prepare data: Pivot to long format, calculate log2 variance, and clean up species names
plot_df <- variance_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Human_Var, Chimp_Var),
    names_to = "Species",
    values_to = "Variance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Clean up names ("Human_Var" -> "Human", "Chimp_Var" -> "Chimp")
    Species = ifelse(Species == "Human_Var", "Human", "Chimp"),
    # Calculate log2 of variance
    log2_Variance = log2(Variance),
    # Ensure correct chronological order of stages
    Timepoint = factor(
      Timepoint,
      levels = c("Day0", "Day2", "Day4", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")
    )
  )

# 2. Generate the plot: Log2 variance for each stage, faceted by Species
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = log2_Variance, fill = Species)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Species, ncol = 1) +  # Facet by species vertically to easily compare stages
  labs(
    title = "Log2 Gene Expression Variance Across Stages",
    x = "Developmental Stage / Timepoint",
    y = "Log2 Variance"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1) # Prevents stage names from overlapping
  )

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = log2_Variance, fill = Species)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Species, nrow = 1) +  # Facet by species vertically to easily compare stages
  labs(
    title = "Log2 Gene Expression Variance Across Stages",
    x = "Developmental Stage / Timepoint",
    y = "Log2 Variance"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-15, 5)) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1) # Prevents stage names from overlapping
  )
```

### No Day 5
```{r RNASeq_FeatureCounts_lcpm_G1_HalfSpeciesTimepoints_No5, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
counts <- RNA_fc_No5
metadata <- RNA_Metadata_No5
log2cpm <- cpm(counts, log=TRUE)

group <- metadata$Cond

keep <- apply(log2cpm, 1, function(gene_expr) {
  any(
    tapply(gene_expr > 1, group, function(x) sum(x) >= 4)
  )
})
  
filtered_counts <- counts[keep, ]

# saveRDS(filtered_counts,"data/QC/concat/Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_No5.RDS")

filtered_log2cpm <- cpm(filtered_counts,log=TRUE)

# saveRDS(filtered_log2cpm,"data/QC/concat/Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_log2cpm_No5.RDS")

hist(filtered_log2cpm, main = "Histogram of filtered counts using lcpm >1 in 4/7 species-timepoints - Day 4",
     xlab =expression("Log"[2]*" counts-per-million"), col =5 )

col_labels <- metadata$SampleName

boxplot(filtered_log2cpm, main = "Boxplots of log cpm per sample with lcpm >1 in 4/7 species-timepoints - Day 4",xaxt = "n", xlab= "")
axis(1,
     at = 1:length(col_labels),  # positions (one per sample)
     labels = col_labels,        # your labels vector
     las = 2,               # rotate text vertically (like srt=90)
     cex.axis = 0.6)        # shrink label size

```

```{r RNASeq_FeatureCounts_lcpm_G1_HalfSpeciesTimepoints_Correlation_No5,fig.width=10,fig.height=10}
counts <- Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_No5
metadata <- RNA_Metadata_No5
log2cpm <- cpm(counts, log=TRUE) 

# Match metadata rows to the order of RNA_log2cpm columns 
metadata <- metadata[ match(colnames(log2cpm), metadata$SampleName), ] 

# Check that all samples matched 
stopifnot(all(metadata$SampleName == colnames(log2cpm))) 

# Optional: check for missing metadata 
stopifnot(!any(is.na(metadata$SampleName)))

######Cor_HeatMap####
Cor_log2cpm <- cor(log2cpm, method = "spearman")
individual <- metadata$Individual
species <- metadata$Species
timepoint <- metadata$Timepoint
timepoint <- factor(timepoint,levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day4","Day15","Day30"))
Cor_metadata <- data.frame(
  sample_cor = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
  species_cor = species,
  timepoint_cor = timepoint,
  individual_cor = individual
)

rownames(Cor_metadata) <- Cor_metadata$sample_cor


pdf("Sample_Sample_Correlation_Heatmap.pdf",
    width = 8,
    height = 8,
    useDingbats = FALSE)

pheatmap(
  Cor_log2cpm,
  fontsize_row = 5,
  fontsize_col = 5,
  annotation_col = Cor_metadata[, c("species_cor", "timepoint_cor", "individual_cor")],
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
  clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
  main = "Sample-Sample Correlation\n(Spearman-log2CPM>1 4 or more in a Species-Timepoint - Day 4)"
)

dev.off()

pheatmap(
  Cor_log2cpm,
  fontsize_row = 5,
  fontsize_col = 5,
  annotation_col = Cor_metadata[, c("species_cor", "timepoint_cor", "individual_cor")],
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
  clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
  main = "Sample-Sample Correlation\n(Spearman-log2CPM>1 4 or more in a Species-Timepoint - Day 4)"
)
```

```{r RNASeq_FeatureCounts_lcpm_G1_HalfSpeciesTimepoints_Correlation_No5_TMM,fig.width=10,fig.height=10}
metadata <- RNA_Metadata_No5
counts <- Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_No5

# Make sure metadata follows the count matrix
metadata <- metadata[
    match(colnames(counts), metadata$SampleName),
]

metadata <- metadata %>% 
  filter(Individual != "H4R")

counts <- counts %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("R"))

metadata$dgelist <- c(rep(c("Human_Day0","Human_Day2","Human_Day4","Human_Day15","Human_Day30","Chimp_Day0","Chimp_Day2","Chimp_Day4","Chimp_Day15","Chimp_Day30"),7))

#create DGEList object
dge <- DGEList(counts = counts)
dge$samples$group <- factor(metadata$dgelist)
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
dge$samples

dim(dge)
dge$samples

log2cpm <- cpm(dge, log=TRUE)

# Match metadata rows to the order of RNA_log2cpm columns 
metadata <- metadata[ match(colnames(log2cpm), metadata$SampleName), ] 

# Check that all samples matched 
stopifnot(all(metadata$SampleName == colnames(log2cpm))) 

# Optional: check for missing metadata 
stopifnot(!any(is.na(metadata$SampleName)))

######Cor_HeatMap####
Cor_log2cpm <- cor(log2cpm, method = "spearman")
individual <- metadata$Individual
species <- metadata$Species
timepoint <- metadata$Timepoint
timepoint <- factor(timepoint,levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day4","Day15","Day30"))
Cor_metadata <- data.frame(
  sample_cor = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
  species_cor = species,
  timepoint_cor = timepoint,
  individual_cor = individual
)

rownames(Cor_metadata) <- Cor_metadata$sample_cor


print(
  pheatmap(Cor_log2cpm,
         fontsize_row = 5,
         fontsize_col = 5,
         annotation_col = Cor_metadata[, c("species_cor", "timepoint_cor","individual_cor")],
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
         clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
         main = "Sample-Sample Correlation\n(Spearman-log2CPM->1 4 or more in a Species-Timpoint - Day 4)\nNoRep\nTMM")
)
```
